text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — final SEO pass for Friday's launch posts. Need keyword map, JSON-LD snippets, internal-link plan, and a redirect sweep. Who can own redirects?
Tom: I can take the redirects. Will need the canonical list and old URL spreadsheet.
Anne: I'll finish the keyword mapping and hand off the intent tiers by EOD. list will include primary/secondary/comms intent.
Leo: For schema, I recommend FAQ + HowTo on pillar pages, and Event markup for the webinar landing. I can draft snippets.
Kate: Webinar landing needs CTA anchors and a consistent utm pattern. Also confirm canonical to the long-form post.
Sam G: Re redirects — are we doing temporary 302s for A/B pages or permanent 301s?
Maria: Good q. For pages we’re retiring -> 301. For experimental variants that might return -> 302. Documenting both patterns now.
Tom: Copying a quick redirect rule set I use:
```
# nginx-style redirects for ops
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /resources/$1 permanent;  # 301
rewrite ^/promo/variant-a$ /promo/main?variant=a redirect;  # 302
```
Anne: Keyword notes: primary target = "webinar landing optimization", secondary = "launch post SEO checklist", alt = "internal linking strategy". I'll attach CSV to the thread.
Leo: Draft JSON-LD for event (short):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-06-10T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
Kate: On internal linking — propose anchor map: hero -> tutorial pillar, webinar CTA -> benchmarks narrative, related posts -> tag hub. Keeps link equity flowing to conversion pages.
Sam G: I'm going to run a quick crawl to find orphaned pages before Tom applies redirects. Will post results here.
seo-bot: crawl finished — 12 orphan pages detected, 7 with low traffic, 5 flagged for redirect. Summary: /old-case-study, /beta-docs/legacy, /2019-posts/*.
Maria: Perfect. Tom — prioritize the 5 flagged ones for 301s. Leave betas as 302s for now.
Tom: Acknowledged. I'll produce a PR with the nginx rules and a list of old->new mappings by 16:30 PT.
Anne: I'll also add sample FAQ schema questions pulled from the webinar script.
Leo: Small nit on microdata — make sure schema strings align with canonical titles to avoid mismatch warnings in GSC.
Kate: One more thing — update the inbound routing for demo signups: route webinar signups to sales-webhook A when utm_campaign=launch2025, otherwise to the nurture flow. I'll paste the routing snippet: 
```
if utm_campaign == 'launch2025': route -> sales-webhook-A
else: route -> nurture-onboard
```
Sam G: I'll test the signup flow in staging after redirects are deployed.
Maria: Action items recap: Anne -> keyword CSV + FAQ copy; Leo -> JSON-LD snippets and schema sanity check; Tom -> redirect PR (301s/302s) + nginx rules; Kate -> anchor/utm routing rules; Sam -> crawl & staging test. We meet 14:30 PT tomorrow to sign off. :thumbsup:
Tom: noted, starting mapping now.
Anne: attaching keywords.csv (will include priority column) — uploading to the drive.
Leo: will post schema snippets to the doc in 30m.
seo-bot: scheduled sitemap ping to Google Search Console at 1766010500.
Maria: thanks team — keep thread updated if blockers pop up.
